connectGuide.title: Use zenstory from your AI coding agent
connectGuide.description: Install the zenstory CLI and skill, and agents like Claude Code, Codex and OpenClaw can read and write your novel projects directly. Requires Node.js 20 or later.
connectGuide.step1: Create an API key (read-only or read/write)
connectGuide.step2: Sign in from your terminal, then paste the key when prompted — it is stored only on your machine
connectGuide.step2Hint: Paste the key when prompted (input is hidden, so it stays out of your shell history).
connectGuide.step3: Install the zenstory skill for your agent
connectGuide.step3Hint: Installs for Claude Code by default; add --target codex or --target openclaw for other agents.
connectGuide.otherAgents: Other AI agents can read the integration guide directly:
